input_data.text_description:
I want to create a design for a drier and washing machine closet. in black or walnut, still dont know the final one. the space is 90 width by 270 height. the width of the drier and washing machine is 60, I do not know the height of them, so use the standard. and obviously we will leave 1 cm from each side for slight ventalation (cabinet will be open from behind, so no worries, and that small because I dont want the machines jumping out of place). the design looksa bit like this:
on the right we have waching machine, above it will be a 22cm drawer, above the drawer will be the drier (it will be high but there is a ladder  for it so no worries from that part). on the left of that whole unit will be shelves. split into three equal spaces. above those two units will be a two door unit that instide will be splitted into two empty spaces.

that is it. the handles will be default staight line handles. in black if the cabinet is in walnut, in gold if the cabinet is in black.
